author_self_test.new_cases: Two host fault injections; termination is an in-process simulation, not a phone crash test.

finding: Success rename could remain visible after directory fsync failure if failure reporting also failed or execution terminated. The original 44-case test did not cover those two windows.
repair: Create a hash-bound completion witness only after result atomic persistence returns successfully; require and re-sync an existing valid witness before accepting prior success. Never manufacture a missing witness or repeat pm clear.
